title: Minimum Path Cost in a Grid
description: Find the minimum cost path from the top-left to the bottom-right of a grid moving only down or right.
pseudocode:
1. dp[0][0] = grid[0][0]
2. for i in rows: for j in cols:
3.   if i > 0 and j > 0:
4.     dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
5.   else if i > 0: dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + dp[i-1][j]
6.   else if j > 0: dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + dp[i][j-1]

steps.note: Calculate cost for first row (move right)
Calculate cost for first column (move down)
Calculate cost for target cell using min of top or left
